stories.h: Gusty storm tonight, strongest north and west of Everett
stories.s: A Pacific storm passing offshore brings heavy rain at times Saturday evening and night. Gusts over 40 mph are likely north and west of Everett, with isolated outages possible; Sunday stays breezy and showery.

stories.h: Paine Field flights hit by nationwide FAA ground stop
stories.s: The FAA halted all U.S. flights Friday afternoon after a telecommunications outage, affecting Everett's airport. Paine Field told travelers to confirm flight status with their airlines.

stories.h: County adopts $3.37B budget on split 3-2 vote
stories.s: The County Council approved the 2027-28 operating budget with higher property taxes. Dissenting member Nathan Nehring tallied about $24 million in new property tax plus other rate hikes and warned of borrowing within three years.

stories.h: Everett mayor pitches $73M plan from transit merger money
stories.s: Mayor Cassie Franklin wants to spend funds from folding Everett Transit into Community Transit on roads, parks and worker transition, plus $30 million toward the planned outdoor stadium. The council will weigh a detailed plan soon.

coming.h: Skate America wraps up in Everett
coming.s: The final session at Angel of the Winds Arena starts at 11 a.m. with the free dance and women's free skate.

coming.h: WSU men's basketball hosts Hawaii in Everett
coming.s: The Cougars play the Rainbow Warriors at Angel of the Winds Arena at 7 p.m.
